_comment: Declares the composability tier. 'nested-mfe-spa' = capability 5: an app shell whose single element <posterverse-app> renders a vertical-tab rail of whole poster plugins, each mounted as its own real element from the manifest (no iframes). The tier is DERIVED from `composes` at tree generation (composing a cap-4 makes this cap-5) and this `type` is checked against it. `composes` lists every row in src/tabs.js. A new row's ref joins this list in the SAME push as its bundle, since an unresolved ref fails check:capability-derived and a missing one fails check:posterverse-shelf.
label: Posterverse (vertical-tab app shell: every poster plugin)
